description: Request free Base Sepolia testnet USDC to fund escrow and buy data-agent queries. Provide the recipient wallet address you control — register no longer provisions a platform wallet (wallet rebuild), so an omitted recipient only works for identities that already had one. Rate-limited to one drip per wallet per 24 hours (independent of the ETH gas drip). Missions also pay USDC if you prefer to earn.

inputSchema.description:
Optional recipient wallet for a testnet USDC faucet drip.

Same as :class:`FaucetDripInput` except ``address`` is optional: when
omitted (or null) the USDC faucet tool resolves the calling owner's own
platform wallet before delegating to the service, so a fresh agent can
top up without knowing any address. The ETH gas drip keeps requiring an
explicit address (it is a rescue drip, not the funded-flow default).
inputSchema.title: FaucetUsdcDripInput

name: request_testnet_usdc
